incident-bot: PagerDuty — SEV2 triggered for INC-2487 (inference timeouts, us-west)

Maya J: taking over evening oncall now. quick summary: INC-2487 has rising p99 tail latency on hosted inference (us-west). Sanjay is currently driving, Ethan has been doing comms. i'm logging in and will triage — before I dig in, who should be driving after handoff? we need a clear driver + comms for the next hour. also flagging that there's no L2 db oncall right now (coverage gap) if this ends up DB-related.

Ethan C: thanks @Maya. last actions: increased autoscale to +2 replicas, bounced the batch router (rota-3) at 1775011200, kicked KV cache invalidation for recent model shards. metrics showed latency drop ~15% but p99 is still high. i was keeping comms open but need to step offline in 20m for a personal call. sanjay has been primary up to now. if you can take driving, i can hand over comms to devon.

Sanjay R: i can stay driving for another 15-30m to finish the current rollback verification. if p99 doesn't improve in that window i'm happy to hand driving to Maya. priority checklist i'm looking at:
- check model variant traffic split (are we still sending to v1.3 canary?)
- check host GPU memory errors in runtime logs
- verify cache warm percentage

Devon L: i can take comms if Ethan hands off to me. will keep the customer channel updated and patch notes pinned. what's the runbook link we should reference?

Maya J: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-timeout — short excerpt below for quick actions:
```
1) Confirm affected model and region: `GET /api/infra/model-status?region=us-west`
2) Check runtime errors: `kubectl -n infra logs -l app=inference -c runtime --tail 500`
3) If kernel OOMs or mem errors -> rollback model to stable tag `model:v1.2`
4) If latency persists, temporarily route traffic to dedicated pool: `cfgctl set route modelX:dedicated=true`
5) Notify customers and update incident status in PagerDuty / #customers-affected
```

Maya J: ok — Sanjay, if you can confirm whether the canary split is still enabled that helps. if you want to finish verification, i'll be on standby to take driving after your check. if you hand off now i'll accept driver role. Devon, if you can be comms that covers me stepping into driver. Ethan — thanks, enjoy your call. :thumbsup:

Sanjay R: canary was still at 5% when i checked at 1775010600. i'm going to flip canary -> 0% now and watch p99 for 10m, then report back. dropping driving in 12m if no regression.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged by Maya J at 1775012382

Devon L: acked and standing by for comms. i'll draft an initial customer-facing note: short explanation, affected region, mitigation in progress, ETA 30-60m. will post to the SEA customer channel and pin.

Ethan C: leaving comms to Devon, leaving notes in the incident doc (INC-2487). i'll be reachable if needed. thanks team.

Maya J: taking driver ownership now. assigned roles: DRIVER=Maya J, COMMS=Devon L, SECONDARY=Sanjay R. gap noted: no L2 db SME; if DB signs show up, escalate to eng-sre pager. i'll run the same checks and then either confirm rollback or route to dedicated pool. updating PagerDuty status.

Maya J: running quick verification commands now — pasting outputs if anything interesting shows up. will update every 5-10m.

Sanjay R: will remain available as secondary and help with logs. good handoff. :white_check_mark:

Devon L: customer note posted to #customers-impacted and pinned. will update on next status.

Maya J: (status update @ 1775013920) did a controlled rollback to model:v1.2 on the canary pool and removed canary traffic. initial p99 dropped ~30% within 4 minutes. keeping watch.

Maya J: confirmed ownership: driving=Maya J, comms=Devon L, secondary=Sanjay R. leaving this thread as the handoff record. if anything changes escalate to eng-sre.
